bounds_helper.source: private void fullBounds(View view,String label,boolean action){

proofs.source: i.runOnMainSync(()->{View root=expected.getWindow().getDecorView();String exit=expected instanceof ChallengePracticeActivity?(suffix.equals("completed")||suffix.equals("random-completed")?"Done":"Cancel preview"):"Cancel practice step";fullBounds(find(root,exit),"Full routine Audio exit",true);

TextView title=(TextView)find(root,suffix.equals("cleanup-recreated")?"Release microphone":"Practice listening");fullBounds(title,"Complete Audio page title",false);assertEquals("One-line Audio title",1,title.getLineCount());assertNotNull(title.getLayout());assertEquals("Unellipsized Audio title",0,title.getLayout().getEllipsisCount(0));

View listen=find(root,"Listen"),stop=find(root,"Stop listening"),retry=find(root,"Retry microphone cleanup");fullBounds(listen!=null?listen:stop!=null?stop:retry,"Actual listening or cleanup action",true);

if(suffix.equals("math")||suffix.equals("fallback")){MathTask math=field(screen(),"math");for(int option:math.options)fullBounds(find(root,"Answer "+option),"Full Math choice",true);fullBounds(find(root,"Check practice answer"),"Full Math Check",true);}

if(suffix.equals("memory-recreated")){WakeCognitiveTask.Memory memory=(WakeCognitiveTask.Memory)cognitive();View board=find(root,"Memory pairs board");fullBounds(board,"Full responsive Memory board",false);assertEquals(memory.card.getWidth()-memory.card.getPaddingLeft()-memory.card.getPaddingRight(),board.getWidth());int width=memory.buttons[0].getWidth();for(Button button:memory.buttons){fullBounds(button,"Full Memory target",true);assertTrue("Equal Memory column widths",Math.abs(width-button.getWidth())<=1);}assertEquals(6,((GridLayout)board).getChildCount());}

void closed()throws Exception{drained();assertFalse(MicrophoneLease.occupied());for(Pcm input:inputs)assertTrue(input.closed);for(Model model:models)assertTrue(model.closed);for(Recognizer recognizer:recognizers)assertTrue(recognizer.closed);i.runOnMainSync(()->{for(Activity activity:owned)if(activity instanceof RoutineAudioPracticeActivity){Handler handler=field(activity,"main");Runnable watch=field(activity,"watch");assertFalse(handler.hasCallbacks(watch));}});}
